SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT

File No. POLICE REGISTRY 8038
S.B. 1 / Add: 8 37
Date August 10, 1937

Subject A. Gind Pell - communication from Japanese Consulate-General
dated 3rd August, 1937.

Made by D.S. Henchman Forwarded by C. Crawford. D.J.

Exhaustive enquiries concerning the whereabouts of
A. Gind Pell, reported to be residing at Flat No. 1, Lane
651 Weihaiwei Road, have proved unavailing.
The name "Gind Pell" is not known in Shanghai and the
above address is unoccupied.
Realising the difficulty in giving a correct
romanization of an occidental name written in Japanese
characters, a search for surnames with similar phonetics was
conducted and it is suggested that "Gind Pell" may possibly
refer to "Gindper."
Mr. Alfred Leopold Gindper, a Russian, is reported
to have relatives living in Dairen and also to be the owner
of property in that town.
He was employed at one time as a clerk in the R.W.D. in
the Shanghai Municipal Council and subsequently established
his own company for the sale of building materials at 24
The Bund, Shanghai.
This company was not successful and Mr. Gindper, it is
stated, is now employed by the Phoenix Trading Co., 11 Hamen
Road, and resides at House 6, Lane 141, Seymour Road. He is
not believed to be the owner of property in Shanghai.
Mr. A. Gindper is a brother of Mr. E. Gindper who
resides at No. 59 Route de Boissezon.

（左侧批注及印章）：
DC(J)
Jenkins

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
特务科第一股
报告

档案号：警务登记处 8038
S.B. 1 / 附件：8 37
日期：1937年8月10日

事由：A. Gind Pell —— 日本总领事馆1937年8月3日来函。

由 D.S. Henchman 呈报，经 C. Crawford. D.J. 转递。

关于据报居住于威海卫路651弄1号的 A. Gind Pell 之下落，经详尽查询，均无结果。
在上海无人知晓“Gind Pell”这一姓名，且上述地址无人居住。
鉴于将用日文字符书写的西方人名进行准确罗马拼音化存在困难，已对发音相似的姓氏进行了检索，推测“Gind Pell”可能系指“Gindper”。
据报，俄国人 Alfred Leopold Gindper 先生在大连有亲属，并在该地拥有产业。
他曾任上海公共租界工部局水务处（R.W.D.）职员，随后在上海外滩24号自立公司，经营建筑材料销售。
该公司经营不善，据称 Gindper 先生现受雇于哈门路11号凤凰贸易公司（Phoenix Trading Co.），居住于西摩路141弄6号。据信他在上海并无产业。
A. Gindper 先生是居住在蒲石路（Route de Boissezon）59号的 E. Gindper 先生的兄弟。

（左侧批注及印章）：
DC(J)
Jenkins
（印：上海总领事馆办公室 1937年8月10日）

Shanki No.1585-2.

Japanese Consulate-General,
Shanghai,
August 3, 1937.

Mr. S. Uyehara,
Deputy Commissioner,
S. M. P.

Re Request For Favour Of Investigation
Re Person Mentioned In Attached Document

Sir,

I have the honour to request your kind
assistance in connection with the enquiry we have
been asked to conduct on behalf of the Civil
Administration Office at Dairen regarding the
individual mentioned in the attached document.

The particular required by the Dairen Authorities
are as follows:

Name: A. Gind Pell (?)
Address: No. 651-1 Weihaiwei Road, Shanghai.
Wanted for default in taxes.

Particular required:

(1) Nationality, present address, date of arrival
in Shanghai.

(2) Locality, nature, amount and estimated value
of property possessed.

(3) Other particulars if available.

Your early attention to this matter will be
greatly appreciated.

I have the honour, to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

Sealed: Chief of Police.
